adminsOnly.title: Admins only
adminsOnly.body: Managing the team is restricted to admins. You're signed in as {email} · {role}. Ask an admin to grant you access.

title: Team
intro: Invite people to the command center and manage their access. Members sign in with Clerk; the role you assign controls what they can see and do.

invite.title: Invite a teammate
invite.body: They'll get an email to sign in. New members land with the role you pick here.
invite.legend: Viewer — read metrics, users, community. Admin — everything, plus PII, push, Sentry & this panel.
